title: 'Frederic, Re di Prussia' to an unknown recipient, BL Add MS 61575 f. 95 (DECODE R8774)

steps.what: Fetched the DECODE record metadata (R8774 and key record R8770) and the single image of R8774 with the session cookie.
Looked at the page: seven lines of plain French spelled by ear and split into syllables, no numbers or signs. Transcribed and read it: a thank-you for teaching the writer 'd'escrire en chiffre'.
Searched for a BL description of Add MS 61575 f. 95 to identify the writer; found only the volume description (copies of the Marlboroughs' ciphers).

outcome.method_basis: BL Add MS 61575 f. 95 is seven lines of plain French thanking someone for teaching the writer to write in cipher; there is nothing enciphered.
outcome.notes: Not a cipher: a clear French note about learning to write in cipher. Writer and recipient unidentified.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
